title: dubai-dld-monthly-stats: Dubai DLD monthly property sales statistics
description: Monthly aggregates of Dubai Land Department (DLD) registered property sales for 2026 year-to-date (Jan–Aug): transaction count, median price (AED), median AED/sqft and off-plan vs ready share by area and property type. Built reproducibly from DLD open data; aggregates only. Not an official DLD product.
